qualification.trajectory_variability: Unresolved at step125; use matched controls and paired confirmation, not a tolerance claim.

subsequent_tuning.promote: compare promising residual rates over complete2900step runs before claiming gains
subsequent_tuning.policy: small cross around best learned setting, then joint LR/WD neighbors if supported; momentum after those
subsequent_tuning.budget: two8H100leases initially4h each; inspect progress frequently, extend only for justified experiments

validation_policy: external HP selection between restarted trials only; never next-loss credit, within-run learning, schedule, or candidate selection
supersedes: Early-start 750-step pilots and abrupt activation after 1000 steps are historical diagnostics.

residual_schedule.formula: peak_lr * clamp((t - 500) / 500, 0, 1); t is zero-indexed GPT iteration
residual_schedule.residual_decay: X <- (1-decay)*X before Adam, after consuming pending credit, from t=500 onward; independent of LR

initial_panel.selection: Between-run endpoint comparisons only; confirm candidates with paired seeds 1 and 2 before claiming improvement.
initial_panel.frozen_control: nominal meta LR1e-5, warmup_steps2900, zero executed residuals throughout; retain moment VJPs for matched instrumentation
